title: Jorge V NDE 4271
content: I was admitted for surgery with high blood-pressure problems. As soon as I was under anesthesia I started seeing images of my life, right back to childhood. I saw my parents, my six brothers, my children and their mothers. I went back over many stages of my life until I came to a stage where I began to see the things I had done wrong, but passing before me in very rapid succession. I then saw my present wife, we were married just two weeks, weeping and begging me not to leave her, asking if God had allowed our union then why was I leaving her. She was saying she loved me; she would always respect me and would love me all her life. I was replying that I also loved her a lot and would do forever, but I could see a dark tunnel and a supernatural force was pulling me inside it. I could still see my wife in the distance but I could not stop myself leaving, until I lost sight of her. That is when I began to understand that I was dying. I asked God to forgive all of my sins and I continued through the tunnel. I saw a brilliant light, which I was approaching at great speed. As I passed into it, I felt a great happiness and peace. I felt so moved at being inside this resplendent place. I seemed to be floating, and then I looked down and saw a group of people gathered around a coffin. I saw my closest relatives and my wife weeping inconsolably, then suddenly this image was fading and something was again pulling me toward the door of light. I came back to the tunnel at great speed. Then, images of cities appeared, many and unfamiliar to me, and I understood that I had come back to this life. I thanked God for this new chance to live. I could see myself preaching in Christian congregations, and always with my present wife by my side. I continued to see images of unknown cities and could see that our bodies had aged. We were old, but continued together in happiness. I then heard a voice, which asked ‘Why are you weeping?’ I opened my eyes and again saw the operating theatre and the anesthetist, who was asking me what I could see. I replied that I was seeing my life, and I went on weeping inconsolably without wanting to. He said ‘You gave us a lot of worry, but thanks to God you are now getting better’, and I passed out again for a moment. One hour later I recovered consciousness completely and that vision, or dream, that I went through is so present in my mind, even after several days, that I feel very happy to have been through this experience.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Looked down and saw a group of people gathered around a coffin, including closest relatives and his wife weeping.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: He described a 'supernatural force' pulling him into a dark tunnel and moving at 'great speed' toward the light; later he returned to the tunnel 'at great speed'.

environment.environment_other_detail: He described being 'inside this resplendent place' after entering a brilliant light.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Return framed as 'this new chance to live' after seeing unfamiliar cities and understanding he had come back to this life.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He saw himself 'preaching in Christian congregations' with his present wife by his side.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Admitted for surgery with high blood-pressure problems; experience began under anesthesia.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He perceived scenes of his wife pleading; later saw a coffin scene with relatives; then unfamiliar cities and a future-like montage; heard a voice asking, 'Why are you weeping?' and returned to the operating theatre.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Life review began immediately under anesthesia before the tunnel; coffin/relatives scene occurred after entering the light; then returned to tunnel and saw unfamiliar cities/future images before waking in the operating theatre.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: He entered the tunnel toward the light, then later 'came back to the tunnel at great speed.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He saw a scene of people around a coffin (including his wife and relatives) while floating and looking down; later saw many unfamiliar cities and an apparent future montage showing himself preaching with his wife and both of them aging.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could see a dark tunnel and a supernatural force was pulling me inside it.”; “I saw a brilliant light, which I was approaching at great speed.”; “As I passed into it, I felt a great happiness and peace.”; “Why are you weeping?”
